description: This file implements a WebSocket server class (WSServer) with methods to start listening for connections, handle upgrades, and close the server. It manages WebSocket connections, delegates request handling, and configures per-message deflate options.

classes.name: WSServer
classes.description: A WebSocket server class that manages WebSocket connections, handles server lifecycle events, and delegates specific behaviors to a delegate object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the WSServer with a delegate object.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the HTTP and WebSocket server, sets up upgrade handling, and returns the WebSocket endpoint URL.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket and HTTP servers, disconnects clients, and cleans up resources.
